context: Sakura and Ren discuss the future of her novels.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: レン兄ちゃん、物語、本当、続く、本当に。
lines.en: Ren—the story really does keep going, doesn't it.
lines.style: Soft opening, almost wondering aloud. Warm certainty underneath the hesitation. Slow, tender pace with a slight lift at the end—checking in with him, not asking permission.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Yeah. I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, genuine. Quick breath before the main thought. Steady warm tone, no performance—just present. Slight pause before 'looking forward,' like he's settling into the weight of meaning.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夢、本当、ずっと、追ってる。
lines.en: I keep chasing the dream. Really. For a long time now.
lines.style: Meditative opening. Hands-like gesture in the voice—reaching. Slight tremor of vulnerability, then steadying. Slow pace, like she's thinking as she speaks. Trails off gently on 'now,' like it's still happening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'll keep cheering you on. Really. Always.
lines.style: Quiet promise, not loud. Soft and firm at once. Breath just under the surface—he means it completely. Slow deliberate pace. Slight lean-in feeling, like he's speaking directly to her core.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm grateful. Really. Always will be.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly at the opening—emotion close. Eyes-down tenderness. Slow, steady pace. Let the gratitude sit before moving on. Soft fade at the end, like it's an ongoing feeling, not a conclusion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Together. That's the real treasure here, truly.
lines.style: Gentle certainty. Slight pause before 'treasure'—he's choosing the word carefully. Warm, almost protective tone. Slow pace. Soft landing on the final word, like he's setting something precious down.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm going to keep trying. Really. No doubt about it.
lines.style: Determined but not loud. Bright quiet conviction underneath. Breath of commitment at the opening. Steady pace, building just slightly toward the end—a gentle promise to herself and to him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: お前の夢、本当、繋がってる。
lines.en: Your dream connects to all of us. Really.
lines.style: Quiet observation, like he's just realized something true. Steady, thoughtful tone. Slight emphasis on 'connects'—gentle but firm. Slow pace. Soft trailing feeling, like he's watching it unfold.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: My precious family. All of you.
lines.style: Voice full but controlled—emotion just barely held. Gentle opening, lingering on the words like she's counting them. Slow, reverent pace. Slight tremor of tenderness, then steadying. Soft fade at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Soft, genuine smile in the voice. Quiet but unmistakable warmth. Slow pace, like he's savoring the feeling. Slight breath before the main thought. Gentle trailing-off, like contentment settling in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: From now on too, okay? Really.
lines.style: Gentle promise forward. Soft opening, checking-in tone. Slow pace, deliberate and tender. Slight lift at 'okay'—drawing him in. Trails off on the final 'really,' like a soft pledge to the future.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'll keep cheering you on. Really. Always.
lines.style: Steady, quiet conviction. Echo of something said before but fresher, deeper. Slow deliberate pace. Warmth without performance. Slight emphasis on 'always'—it lands like a vow. Soft close.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm so happy about this. Really, truly.
lines.style: Full-heart close. Voice bright but soft, not loud. Breath of relief and tenderness at the opening. Slow, lingering pace—like she's committing the moment to memory. Slight tremor of genuine emotion. Gentle, satisfied trailing-off at the very end.
